# GLAD OpenGL loader

The files in this directory were generated by GLAD 2.0.6 from pinned Git
revision `658f48e72aee3c6582e80b05ac0f8787a64fe6bb` for OpenGL 3.3 core plus
`GL_KHR_debug`:

```text
python -m glad --out-path third_party/glad --api gl:core=3.3 \
  --extensions GL_KHR_debug --reproducible c
```

They are checked in intentionally. A normal build therefore needs no Python,
Jinja2, GLAD network request, generated-file copy step, or runtime loader DLL.
The generated headers identify their applicable SPDX licenses; the upstream
generator is MIT-licensed.
